instruction: Change Ubuntu's desktop to show all mounted volumes on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling display of mounted volumes on Ubuntu desktop. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent enabled it (changed to true). Uses GNOME desktop icons schema.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction by checking the GNOME desktop setting 'org.gnome.shell.extensions.ding show-volumes'
Getter (get_vm_command_line) executes the correct command 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell.extensions.ding show-volumes' to extract the current setting state
Metric (exact_match) performs the appropriate comparison - exact string matching is correct for gsettings boolean values
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct - matches the actual output format of gsettings get command (includes trailing newline)
Complete coverage - the evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction (showing mounted volumes on desktop)
Data flow is correct - command output string is compared against expected string value with proper format
Edge cases handled - if command fails (returns None), exact_match will correctly return 0.0
